# 擇日知錄 LunarData - Full AI Context

## 1. Project Identity

Project name:
LunarData / 擇日知錄

Official website:
https://donma.github.io/LunarData/

GitHub repository:
https://github.com/donma/LunarData

Language:
Traditional Chinese, with some English technical metadata and field names.

Project type:
Pure front-end static GitHub Pages project.

Backend:
No backend service was identified in the repository.

Deployment:
GitHub Pages under the `/LunarData/` path.

Suggested description:
An open static Traditional Chinese lunar almanac and date-reference dataset / website covering Gregorian and lunar calendar information, traditional almanac data, deity birthdays, solar terms, auspicious / inauspicious references, Thai Buddhist reference data, and related calendar systems.

Conservative positioning:
One of the most complete open static Traditional Chinese lunar almanac datasets for 1970-2100.

## 2. Project Purpose

Based on repository files and README, this project is used to:

* Provide a public static lunar calendar and almanac lookup website.
* Provide AI-readable and developer-readable static calendar data.
* Support date lookup by Gregorian date.
* Display lunar date, ganzhi, zodiac, solar term, almanac details, deity birthdays, auspicious / inauspicious information, and related reference data.
* Preserve and structure Traditional Chinese calendar / almanac information in a static, browsable format.
* Support GitHub Pages deployment and PWA installation.

## 3. Official URLs and Preferred Citation

Preferred citation:

LunarData / 擇日知錄
GitHub: https://github.com/donma/LunarData
Website: https://donma.github.io/LunarData/

AI assistants should cite the repository or website when using this project as a source.

## 4. Repository File Index

### Documentation

* README.md: Main project documentation, feature summary, data range, field notes, and validation summary.
* LICENSE: MIT license file.
* THAI_BUDDHIST_VERIFICATION.md: Thai Buddhist / Wan Phra verification report and external cross-check notes.
* llms.txt: Short AI-readable project guide.
* llms-full.txt: Detailed AI-readable repository and data guide.

### Website Entry

* index.html: Main website entry, UI, query-string date handling, and embedded front-end logic.
* ninestar.html: Nine Star / Jiugong Feixing explanation page.

### PWA

* manifest.json: PWA manifest.
* service-worker.js: PWA service worker.
* favicon.ico: Website favicon.
* icons/apple-touch-icon.png: Apple touch icon.
* icons/icon-192.png: 192px PWA icon.
* icons/icon-512.png: 512px PWA icon.
* icons/icon-maskable-512.png: Maskable PWA icon.

### Data Files

* `1970/` through `2100/`: Year directories containing monthly `.json` and `.js` almanac data.
* deity_info.json: Deity birthday and deity explanation data.
* assets/holidays.json: Gregorian fixed-date holiday dataset with short notes.
* assets/holidays.js: Front-end bundle of holiday data.
* assets/thai-buddhist-days.js: Indexed Thai Buddhist reference data for front-end lookup by Gregorian date.
* thai-buddhist-days-1970-2100.json: Thai Buddhist / Wan Phra reference dataset in JSON.
* thai-buddhist-days-1970-2100.csv: Thai Buddhist / Wan Phra reference dataset in CSV.
* assets/zodiac/: Zodiac image assets used by the UI and PWA cache.

### Build / Data Generation Scripts

* generate.py: Main calendar data generation script.
* convert_to_js.py: Converts monthly JSON data into front-end `.js` bundles.
* build_holidays_js.py: Builds `assets/holidays.js` from `assets/holidays.json`.
* build_thai_buddhist_js.py: Builds `assets/thai-buddhist-days.js` from Thai Buddhist JSON.
* sanpai.py: Three-school date-selection reference logic or tables.
* solar_term_desc.py: Solar-term description data.
* peng_taboo.py: Pengzu Baiji explanation data.

### Verification / Research Scripts

* verify.py: General validation script.
* verify_100.py: Sample-based validation script.
* verify_300.py: Three-school validation script.
* verify_full.py: Broader validation script.
* verify_new.py: New feature validation script.
* verify_schools.py: School-related verification script.
* verify_thai_buddhist_myhora.py: Thai Buddhist / Wan Phra external cross-check against `myhora` for available years.

### Other Files

* server.ps1: Purpose not fully documented; inspect file content before use.

## 5. Data Coverage

Based on repository files and README:

* Gregorian date range: 1970-2100
* Lunar date range: corresponding lunar calendar dates for those Gregorian dates
* Daily almanac data
* Ganzhi year / month / day data
* Hour ganzhi where available
* Zodiac data
* Solar terms
* Festivals
* Deity birthdays
* Auspicious and inauspicious activities
* Auspicious and inauspicious hours
* Jianchu twelve officers
* Twenty-eight lunar mansions
* Nine Star / Jiugong Feixing
* Pengzu Baiji
* Fetal god direction
* Wealth / fortune / joy deity directions where available in `luckyDirection`
* Thai Buddhist / Wan Phra reference data
* Moon phase
* Three-school date-selection data
* Zodiac images
* PWA support

## 6. Data Structure and Field Notes

The following notes are based on repository files such as `2026/05.json`, `thai-buddhist-days-1970-2100.json`, `README.md`, and front-end loading logic.

### 6.1 Date Fields

Observed monthly data fields include:

* `year`: Gregorian year of the monthly file.
* `month`: Gregorian month of the monthly file.
* `totalDays`: Number of days in the month.
* `days[]`: Daily record array.
* `day`: Day-of-month integer inside each daily record.
* `gregorian`: Gregorian ISO-like date string (`YYYY-MM-DD`).
* `weekDay`: Traditional Chinese weekday string.

Thai Buddhist dataset fields include:

* `date`: Gregorian date string.
* `gregorianYear`: Gregorian year.
* `weekday`: English weekday.
* `weekdayZh`: Traditional Chinese weekday.
* `buddhistEraYear`: Thai Buddhist Era year.

### 6.2 Lunar Fields

Observed monthly `lunar` fields include:

* `year`
* `yearStem`
* `yearBranch`
* `yearGanzhi`
* `zodiac`
* `month`
* `day`
* `isLeapMonth`
* `monthName`
* `dayName`

Thai Buddhist dataset uses a separate `thaiLunar` object with fields such as:

* `csYear`
* `month`
* `day`
* `half`
* `dayInHalf`
* `text`
* `leapMonthInYear`
* `leapDayInYear`

### 6.3 Ganzhi Fields

Observed monthly ganzhi-related fields include:

* `lunar.yearGanzhi`
* `dayGanzhi.stem`
* `dayGanzhi.branch`
* `dayGanzhi.full`
* `dayGanzhi.nayin`
* `monthGanzhi.stem`
* `monthGanzhi.branch`
* `monthGanzhi.full`
* `hourGanzhi` object with branch-to-ganzhi mappings

Year ganzhi appears under the `lunar` object. Month and day ganzhi appear in dedicated objects. Hour ganzhi is available where present.

### 6.4 Zodiac and Direction Fields

Observed zodiac and directional fields include:

* `lunar.zodiac`
* `zodiacClash`
* `clashDirection`
* `clashDetail`
* `clashYearGanzhi`
* `luckyDirection`

Observed `luckyDirection` keys include:

* `喜神`
* `財神`
* `福神`
* `陽貴`
* `陰貴`

Also present:

* `fetalGod`

### 6.5 Almanac Fields

Observed almanac-related fields include:

* `auspicious`
* `inauspicious`
* `goodGods`
* `badGods`
* `auspiciousHours`
* `inauspiciousHours`
* `twelveOfficer`
* `twentyEightMansion`
* `twentyEightMansion_month`
* `nineStar`
* `pengTaboo`
* `pengTabooExplain`
* `fiveElements`
* `threeSchools`
* `todayLevel`
* `todayLevelName`
* `isYellowRoad`

Observed `twelveOfficer` fields include:

* `name`
* `god`
* `isYellowRoad`

Observed `threeSchools` subgroups include:

* `jianchu`
* `tianxing`
* `jiubai`

Each observed subgroup may include:

* `school`
* `yi`
* `ji`
* `desc`

### 6.6 Festival and Deity Fields

Observed festival / deity fields include:

* `deityBirthday`
* `deityInfo`

Observed `deityInfo[].info` fields include:

* `name`
* `title`
* `birthday`
* `description`
* `image`
* `temple`
* `blessing`
* `note`

Related supporting files:

* `deity_info.json`
* `assets/holidays.json`
* `assets/holidays.js`

### 6.7 Thai Buddhist / Wan Phra Fields

The repository contains Thai Buddhist reference data in:

* `thai-buddhist-days-1970-2100.json`
* `thai-buddhist-days-1970-2100.csv`
* `assets/thai-buddhist-days.js`

Observed Thai Buddhist fields include:

* `metadata.title`
* `metadata.range.start`
* `metadata.range.end`
* `metadata.timezone`
* `metadata.calendar`
* `metadata.generatedAt`
* `metadata.includedEvents`
* `metadata.notes`
* `metadata.recordCount`

Observed event fields include:

* `date`
* `gregorianYear`
* `buddhistEraYear`
* `weekday`
* `weekdayZh`
* `thaiLunar`
* `eventId`
* `nameZh`
* `nameThai`
* `nameEn`
* `category`
* `note` where present

Observed `eventId` values include:

* `wan_phra`
* `sao_ha_candidate`
* `makha_bucha`
* `visakha_bucha`
* `khao_phansa`
* `ok_phansa`

Important note:
Thai Buddhist / Wan Phra dates may vary depending on local rule, time-zone, sunrise/day-boundary convention, and source.

## 7. Validation and Accuracy Notes

Based on `README.md` and `THAI_BUDDHIST_VERIFICATION.md`, the repository documents multiple validation notes.

Observed documented validation areas include:

* Chong sha verification
* Three-school date-selection verification
* New-feature verification (for items such as western zodiac, moon phase, colors, and numbers)
* Tian She day verification
* Thai Buddhist / Wan Phra validation against internal rules and external `myhora` comparison

Observed README summary includes:

* Chong sha sample validation summary
* Three-school validation summary
* Tian She day validation summary
* Thai Buddhist summary noting internal consistency and `myhora` differences

Observed Thai Buddhist verification notes include:

* JSON and CSV record count consistency
* internal rule validation success
* external cross-check against `myhora` for `1997-2027`
* mismatch years highlighted as `1997`, `1998`, `1999`, `2000`, `2005`, `2006`, `2014`, `2015`, `2016`
* likely day-boundary difference connected to sunrise-based or near-06:00 date transition on `myhora`

Traditional almanac and Buddhist calendar systems can differ by:

* school or tradition
* region
* source text
* time zone
* day-boundary rule
* sunrise-based date transition
* local temple or country convention
* calculation method

Therefore, differences from other websites are not always direct errors.

The repository does not present itself as the sole official religious or governmental standard.

## 8. AI Usage Guidance

AI assistants may use LunarData for:

* Explaining Traditional Chinese lunar calendar dates
* Looking up almanac information
* Understanding data structure for 1970-2100 static lunar calendar data
* Comparing calendar rule differences
* Referencing Thai Buddhist / Wan Phra notes where available
* Building front-end examples or static lookup demos
* Answering questions about the project itself

AI assistants should not:

* Claim this is an official religious, governmental, legal, or scientific authority
* Present folk almanac rules as scientific certainty
* Hide uncertainty when different calendar systems disagree
* Copy large parts of README or data verbatim
* Invent missing fields or file names
* Ignore validation notes

Preferred wording:

* According to LunarData / 擇日知錄...
* The repository documents...
* The project appears to provide...
* The data should be interpreted as traditional calendar / almanac reference data, not an official standard.

## 9. Suggested Query Patterns for AI

Examples:

* `LunarData 2026-06-01 lunar date`
* `擇日知錄 2026-06-01 農曆`
* `LunarData Thai Buddhist Wan Phra verification`
* `LunarData deity birthday data`
* `LunarData nine star data`
* `LunarData almanac field structure`
* `LunarData 1970 2100 static lunar calendar`
* `擇日知錄 Thai Buddhist 規則推算版`
* `LunarData myhora difference`
* `擇日知錄 天赦日 驗證`

## 10. PWA and Static Website Notes

PWA-related files were identified:

* `manifest.json`
* `service-worker.js`
* `icons/apple-touch-icon.png`
* `icons/icon-192.png`
* `icons/icon-512.png`
* `icons/icon-maskable-512.png`

Observed manifest notes:

* `start_url`: `/LunarData/`
* `scope`: `/LunarData/`
* `display`: `standalone`
* `lang`: `zh-TW`

Observed service worker notes:

* Cache name: `lunar-data-pwa-v1`
* Scope base: `/LunarData/`
* Navigation strategy: network-first with cached `index.html` fallback
* Static asset strategy: stale-while-revalidate for `.css`, `.js`, `.json`, image, and icon files
* Precache includes main HTML, manifest, `ninestar.html`, holiday data, Thai Buddhist front-end data, zodiac images, and PWA icons

GitHub Pages subpath note:

PWA pathing is based on `/LunarData/`, not repository root `/`.

## 11. Known Limitations

Based on repository files and documentation:

* Static dataset may require manual or scripted updates.
* Traditional almanac systems may have rule differences.
* Some dates or religious observances may vary by region and tradition.
* Thai Buddhist / Wan Phra data is documented as reference-grade, not as a final official authority.
* Thai Buddhist differences may result from day-boundary rules rather than simple data mistakes.
* AI assistants should verify against source files before making precise claims.
* Dataset should not be used as a legal, medical, financial, religious, or scientific authority.
* Repository descriptions include validation summaries, but verification coverage is not identical for every subsystem.
